title: MCP 2026 Official Roadmap — Stateless Servers & .well-known Metadata
description: The official MCP maintainers published the 2026 roadmap (March 5-6, 2026) outlining the next protocol evolution. Key planned features: (1) Stateless server architecture — evolve transport/session model so MCP servers scale horizontally without maintaining per-machine state (directly relevant to cloud-native deployments); (2) .well-known metadata format — a standard endpoint so server capabilities are discoverable without a live connection (enables MCP registries and discovery tools); (3) Enhanced streaming — richer async operations; (4) Richer resource types; (5) Improved sampling for multi-agent workflows — MCP servers can trigger model calls themselves, enabling server-side agentic behaviors. AWS's Bedrock AgentCore Runtime (announced March 10, 2026 in 14 regions) already implements a 'managed MCP' interpretation requiring stateless streamable-HTTP servers. This is the authoritative direction signal for the MCP ecosystem through 2026.
notes: Not immediately actionable — features are planned, not released. Monitor blog.modelcontextprotocol.io for spec publication. High architectural significance: stateless servers would allow our MCP servers to be deployed without sticky sessions. .well-known metadata would enable automated MCP discovery without manual config. Re-evaluate when any of these features ship in Claude Code.
